children: September 9, 2026 SURREY, British Columbia - TheNewswire – Cameo Resources Inc. (CSE: MEO FSE: Z88) (“Cameo” or the “Company”) is pleased to announce the appointment of Duranya Sebabili as Director and Country Manager, Tanzania, expanding his role with the Company as Cameo prepares to commence its inaugural drill program at the Katoro Gold Project.

Mr. Sebabili has worked with Cameo in Tanzania since 2023, serving as the Company’s in-country representative and supporting its engagement with government authorities, regulatory bodies and local stakeholders. During that time, he has played an important role in advancing Cameo’s interests in Tanzania, including helping secure regulatory approvals for two mineral rights zones.

With more than 10 years of experience spanning public administration, government relations, regulatory affairs and stakeholder engagement, Mr. Sebabili brings extensive experience navigating government and regulatory processes and coordinating public-private stakeholders.

In his expanded role, Mr. Sebabili will oversee Cameo’s in-country activities and manage the upcoming Katoro drilling program. He is already working closely with Cameo’s Tanzanian drilling contractor to coordinate program planning, logistics and execution on the ground.

“Duranya has already proven to be an invaluable part of our team in Tanzania,” said Brent Strasler, President & CEO of Cameo Resources. “His knowledge of the local regulatory environment, relationships with government and stakeholders, and ability to get things done on the ground have been instrumental as we advance Katoro. Expanding his role was a natural next step, and we’re very pleased to have him leading our in-country operations as we prepare to commence drilling.”

The Katoro Gold Project is located in Tanzania’s Lake Victoria Goldfields, immediately south of TRX Gold’s Buckreef Gold Project. Cameo is preparing its inaugural drill program to test priority targets identified through geological, geophysical and surface exploration work.

Cameo Resources Inc. is a dynamic mineral exploration company dedicated to discovering and developing valuable mineral deposits. Cameo’s Katoro property covers 19.58 Km2 situated within the prospective Sukumaland greenstone belt within the Lake Victoria goldfield (LVGF). One of the most important mining sites in Africa, Tanzania’s LVGF holds several multimillion-ounce gold deposits and has continuing operations by some of the largest gold companies in the world. The concessions have not been explored by modern methods until now. For more information on Cameo Resources, please visit the website at www.cameoresourcesinc.com.
On behalf of the Board of Cameo Resources Inc.
